meta.subject: fixed resadd bug by reverting critical path fix

en.summary: This commit fixes a resadd correctness regression by restoring write hazard checks and stricter ordering in accumulator-backed read-modify-write paths.
why_it_counts: It changes DUT behavior in AccumulatorMem, LoopMatmul, and Scratchpad rather than tests or tooling.
AccumulatorMem stops accepting every write unconditionally and again blocks same-address pipelined accumulator writes.
LoopMatmul and Scratchpad also restore stricter resadd load arbitration and ordered issue sequencing, consistent with a real ordering bug.
evidence: AccumulatorMem.scala changes io.write.ready from true.B back to a predicate that blocks writes on block_write_req and same-address pipelined accumulator writes.
LoopMatmul.scala adds A_not_done and resadd_forceA so resadd arbitration keeps favoring the A-side until paired loads have drained.
Scratchpad.scala removes the relaxed write_norm_q bypass, routes accumulator-backed writes through the scale issue path, and updates busy and dmawrite gating accordingly.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Residual-add or accumulator read-modify-write paths rely on strict ordering between reading the old accumulator value, combining it with new data, and writing the result back. A so-called critical-path optimization that removes same-address backpressure or lets paired source streams switch too early can cause stale reads, overwritten partial sums, or mismatched operands. That is the portable bug mechanism here: relaxed ordering in a correctness-sensitive accumulator path.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A residual-add style workload issues accumulator-backed writes that can overlap in address or depends on tightly paired A/B load streams.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drop the same-address write hazard guard and relax the paired-load or issue-queue ordering so accumulator operations can overlap unsafely.
portability_notes: Map this to any design where an accumulator or partial-sum memory is read, transformed, and written back under DMA or loop-controller control.
The easiest faithful injection is usually to accept writes unconditionally even when an older write to the same location is still in flight.
If the target DUT also has paired operand streams for resadd, relaxing the stream-stickiness or pairing rule is an additional faithful mutation.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the accumulator memory write-ready or enqueue guard that blocks same-address overlapping writes.
Remove that guard so writes are accepted even when the same address is still present in a pipeline or write queue.
Optionally relax any paired-load arbitration or queueing rule that keeps A/B operand streams aligned for residual-add operations.
Run a resadd workload with repeated writes to the same accumulator region and check for intermittent wrong sums.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AccumulatorMem write.ready hazard gating, LoopMatmul resadd load arbitration, and Scratchpad ordered write-scale issue path
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix restores AccumulatorMem same-address write blocking, keeps resadd A-side arbitration sticky until outstanding loads drain, and removes the relaxed Scratchpad bypass that had reordered accumulator-backed write processing.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Set AccumulatorMem io.write.ready back to true.B or otherwise remove the same-address pipelined write predicate; optionally also revert the resadd_forceA and ordered write-scale queue changes.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Residual-add results become intermittently wrong because accumulator values are read or written out of order, or paired resadd operands lose alignment.
evidence_for_injection: The AccumulatorMem change alone is a textbook same-address hazard restoration and is directly injectable.
The related LoopMatmul and Scratchpad changes all move in the same direction: reintroducing ordering and removing a too-aggressive fast path.
The commit message explicitly ties the regression to a prior critical-path fix, which matches an ordering/backpressure bug rather than a functional algorithm change.
notes: For a single portable mutation, the AccumulatorMem write-ready hazard check is the cleanest injection point.
The broader commit shows the bug family affected multiple ordering points in the resadd pipeline.

zh.summary: 该提交通过恢复写冲突检查和更严格的顺序约束，修复了 accumulator 支持的 resadd 读改写路径中的正确性回归。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是 AccumulatorMem、LoopMatmul 和 Scratchpad 中的 DUT 行为，而不是测试或工具链。
AccumulatorMem 不再无条件接受所有写入，而是重新阻止同地址的流水化 accumulator 写冲突。
LoopMatmul 和 Scratchpad 也一起恢复了更严格的 resadd load 仲裁与有序 issue 序列，符合真实顺序错误的特征。
evidence: AccumulatorMem.scala 把 io.write.ready 从 true.B 改回一个谓词：在 block_write_req 或同地址流水化 accumulator 写存在时阻止新写入。
LoopMatmul.scala 新增了 A_not_done 与 resadd_forceA，使 resadd 仲裁会持续优先 A 侧直到成对 load 排空。
Scratchpad.scala 去掉了放松顺序的 write_norm_q 绕过路径，把 accumulator-backed 写重新路由到 scale issue 路径，并相应更新了 busy 与 dmawrite 门控。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 残差相加或 accumulator 读改写路径依赖严格的顺序：先读取旧 accumulator 值，再与新数据组合，最后把结果写回。所谓的“关键路径优化”如果去掉了同地址回压，或者让成对源流过早切换，就会导致读取陈旧值、部分和被覆盖、或者操作数错配。这里可移植的 bug 机理就是在正确性敏感的 accumulator 路径上放松了顺序约束。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: resadd 的读改写顺序约束
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: residual-add 风格工作负载发出可能同地址重叠的 accumulator 写，或者依赖严格成对对齐的 A/B 载入流。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除同地址写冲突保护，并放松成对 load 或 issue 队列的顺序，使 accumulator 操作发生不安全重叠。
portability_notes: 把它映射到任何在 DMA 或 loop-controller 驱动下，对 accumulator 或 partial-sum memory 做读、变换、再写回的设计。
最容易忠实复现的注入点通常是：即使同一位置的旧写仍在流水或写队列中，也无条件接受新写。
如果目标 DUT 还存在成对的 resadd 操作数流，那么放松该配对或粘滞仲裁规则也是等价且忠实的变异。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 accumulator memory 写入 ready 或入队保护逻辑，它会阻止同地址重叠写。
删除该保护，使得即便相同地址仍在 pipeline 或写队列中，也继续接受新写入。
可选地放松保持 resadd A/B 操作数流对齐的成对 load 仲裁或队列规则。
运行会反复写同一 accumulator 区域的 resadd 工作负载，并检查是否出现间歇性错误求和。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AccumulatorMem 的 write.ready 冲突门控、LoopMatmul 的 resadd load 仲裁，以及 Scratchpad 的有序 write-scale issue 路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复恢复了 AccumulatorMem 中同地址写阻塞，保持 resadd A 侧仲裁在 outstanding load 排空前持续生效，并移除了会重排 accumulator-backed 写处理的 Scratchpad 放松旁路。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 AccumulatorMem 的 io.write.ready 改回 true.B，或者删除其中同地址流水写谓词；也可进一步回退 resadd_forceA 和有序 write-scale queue 的修改。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: resadd 结果会间歇性出错，因为 accumulator 值发生了乱序读写，或者成对的 resadd 操作数失去了对齐。
evidence_for_injection: 仅 AccumulatorMem 这一处变化本身就是典型的同地址 hazard 恢复，且非常适合直接注入。
相关的 LoopMatmul 和 Scratchpad 改动都朝着同一个方向变化：恢复顺序性，去掉过于激进的 fast path。
提交信息明确把回归归因于早先的 critical-path 修复，这与顺序/回压 bug 完全吻合，而不是算法本身改变。
notes: 如果只选择一个可移植变异点，优先使用 AccumulatorMem 的 write-ready 冲突保护。
从更广的角度看，这个提交表明 resadd 流水线中有多个顺序点都曾被同一类 bug 影响。
